name: Q01 blockQuoteMarkerRunEnd: the marker is another character
Q02 blockQuoteMarkerRunEnd: one marker only
Q03 blockQuoteMarkerRunEnd: the blanks after a marker are all taken
why: every blank after a marker is taken

name: Q04 blockQuoteMarkerRunEnd: the optional blank is a tab
why: a tab after the marker is taken, a space is not

name: Q05 blockQuoteMarkerRunEnd: no optional blank
Q06 blockQuoteMarkerRunEnd: the first character is skipped
why: the run starts one character late

name: Q07 blockQuoteMarkerRunEnd: ends one early
Q08 blockQuoteMarkerRunEnd: answers -1 for no run
why: nothing found answers -1, which the caller compares with the start

name: Q09 blockQuoteMarkerRunEnd: a tab is also the optional blank
why: a tab after the marker is also taken

name: Q10 blockQuoteMarkerRunEnd: the run is capped at 65,536 markers
why: a cap on the run (two characters a marker here): only a run past 131,072 characters sees it

name: Q11 blockQuoteMarkerRunEnd: the run is capped at 2^20 characters
why: only a run past a million characters sees it

name: W01 blockQuotePrefix: the run is read from the start of the line, not after the indent
why: an indented marker would not be seen: the older qmd-model rows

name: W02 blockQuotePrefix: no marker is answered as a prefix of the indent
from: return end === indent.length ? null : line.slice(0, end);
why: an indented line with no marker would be a quote: the older qmd-model rows

name: W03 blockQuotePrefix: the prefix drops the indent
from: return end === indent.length ? null : line.slice(0, end);
to: return end === indent.length ? null : line.slice(indent.length, end);
why: the prefix would not cover the indent: contentStart and offsets move

name: W04 blockQuotePrefix: the run is read before the code-depth test
from:
const end = blockQuoteMarkerRunEnd(line, indent.length);
  return end === indent.length ? null : line.slice(0, end);
to:
const end = blockQuoteMarkerRunEnd(line, indent.length);
  return end === indent.length || end < 0 ? null : line.slice(0, end);
why: no change in the answer (end is never negative): argued equivalent
